    Corollary 12.1: all modules over a positive deformation #

    deformation-refinements.tex: every positive filtered deformation B of A₀ is representation-finite, and the lifted normalized modules M_x^B exhaust its indecomposables.

    Formalization. The lifted modules carry mesh data (meshB, LiftedMeshData.lean) with the injective labels of A₀ (injB, the dimensions agree with C by finrank_FB), and their corner algebra at the projective labels is B (cornerEquiv, LiftedCorner.lean). Proposition 2.10 applied to this mesh data gives representation-finiteness, and every indecomposable is an evaluated module; the evaluation of M_x^B at the regular projectives φ(e_p) B ≅ M_p^B is M_x^B itself (evIso).

    Evaluation at the regular projectives #
